footer.credits.other: Credits are accounting units used inside one network. They are a record of who has given and received value; they have no value outside it and are not guaranteed to be accepted.

session.ending.other: Your session is about to end.

dashboard.explain.other: Available to spend is not your balance: pending outgoing trades reduce it.

notice.closing_date.other: This network closes on %[1]s. You can keep trading until then. Download your data before the date; read access continues for a while afterwards.

notice.membership_suspended.other: Your membership is suspended. You can view your trades and history, and decline or withdraw trades, but you cannot propose, accept or post. Contact the network administrator to ask about restoring it.

notice.membership_departed.other: You have left this network. You can still read your history and download your data.

notice.network_closed.other: This network is closed. History stays readable and exports are available; new trades are not possible.

notice.network_closing.other: This network has reached its closing date and is completing its closure. New trades are not possible; history stays readable and exports are available.

notice.admin_required.other: This network has no active administrator, so it is read-only (administrator required). You can read balances and history and download your data; nothing that moves value is possible until an administrator is appointed.

notice.trading_paused.other: Trading in this network is paused (suspended). You can read balances and history and download your data; new trades and acceptances are not possible until it resumes.

auth.hint.login_new.other: At least 3 characters, no spaces. An email address works well.

auth.hint.password_rules.other: At least 12 characters. A password manager is fine; pasting is allowed.

auth.hint.signin_code.other: For example 123456, or ABCDE-FGHIJ. Each code works once.

auth.hint.recovery_format.other: Looks like ABCD-EFGH-IJKL-MNOP. Capital letters and dashes are optional.

auth.login.join_info.other: To join a network you need an invitation link from its administrator, or the network's join page.

auth.login.recover_tail.other: with one of your recovery codes.

auth.mfa_step.intro.other: Your password was correct. Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app, or one unused recovery code. This step expires in 5 minutes.

auth.recover.intro.other: Lost your password? Enter your login, one of your recovery codes and a new password. Each code works once. If you have no codes left, ask your network administrator to reset your password.

auth.codes.shown_once.other: This is the only time they are shown.

auth.codes.keep_safe.other: Write them down or print them and keep them somewhere safe and separate from your password manager. Each code works once. Any codes you had before no longer work.

auth.codes.purpose.other: Recovery codes let you set a new password if you forget it, without email.

auth.codes.replace_note.other: Making new codes replaces all the old ones. You need your current password.

security.mfa.off_explain.other: Turn it on to protect your account if your password is stolen. Administrators may be required to use it.

security.codes.explain.other: A recovery code lets you set a new password without email if you forget it.

security.codes.link.other: Make or replace password recovery codes

security.notices.advice.other: If you do not recognise a change, change your password and turn on two-step sign-in.

auth.enrol.already_on.other: Two-step sign-in is already on. Manage it on the

auth.enrol.need_password.other: For your security, enter your password to start.

auth.enrol.step_key.other: In your authenticator app choose to add an account by entering a key, and type this setup key. Choose time-based, 6 digits, 30 seconds.

auth.enrol.uri_note.other: Apps that import links can use this address instead:

auth.enrol.step_confirm.other: Enter the 6-digit code the app shows to confirm.

auth.enrol.expiry.other: This setup key is shown only while setup is in progress and expires after 15 minutes.

auth.save.body.other: They are shown only once and cannot be shown again. Each code works one time if you lose access to your authenticator app. Keep them somewhere safe, such as a password manager or a printed copy.

auth.password.intro.other: Changing your password signs you out on every device. API tokens you created keep working until you revoke them.

setup.currency.hint.other: A singular word, for example credit or hour.

setup.grant.hint.other: Credits given to each new member. Use 0 for none.

setup.grant.risk.other: I accept the risk of open joining together with a grant: everyone who joins receives it, including people who join by themselves, so anyone can collect it again by opening new accounts. Only needed for that combination.

join.rules.other: By joining you agree to follow this network's rules. Credits are accounting units inside the network.

sessions.explain.other: These are your active sign-ins. You can end any session you no longer use. Times reflect the current session limits; activity can extend the idle timeout.

sessions.none.other: There are no active sessions on this page.

sessions.current_consequence.other: You will be signed out here and must sign in again to continue. Your other sessions and API tokens will keep working.

sessions.other_consequence.other: This sign-in will stop working immediately. You will stay signed in here. Your other sessions and API tokens will keep working.

sessions.confirm_label.other: I want to end this session.

sessions.confirm_required.other: Not signed out. Confirm that you want to end this session. Nothing changed.

sessions.current_ended.other: This session has ended. Sign in again to continue.

sessions.other_ended.other: The selected session has ended. You are still signed in here.

sessions.security_intro.other: Review your sign-ins and end sessions you no longer use.

sessions.bulk_consequence.other: Your other sign-ins will stop working immediately, and any sign-in waiting for a two-step code will need to start again. You will stay signed in here. Your API tokens will keep working.

sessions.bulk_confirm.other: I want to end all my other sessions.

sessions.bulk_required.other: Not signed out. Confirm that you want to end your other sessions. Nothing changed.

sessions.bulk_ended.other: Your other sessions have ended. You are still signed in here.

sessions.help_inventory.other: Open Security, then Manage active sessions. This session identifies the browser you are using. Signed in, Last active, and Ends by show the recorded times; staying active can extend an idle timeout, but the maximum session lifetime still applies.

sessions.help_paging.other: Use Next page for older sign-ins, Previous page for newer sign-ins, and First page to refresh the newest page. A page can contain no active sessions while more pages remain, because expired and ended sign-ins are skipped in bounded groups. New sign-ins or revocations can change a page while you browse. If the requested newer page is no longer available, the newest page is shown.

sessions.help_revoke.other: Choose Sign out this session beside a sign-in, review its times, tick the confirmation, and choose End session. Opening the confirmation page changes nothing. Sign out here ends the browser you are using and returns you to sign-in.

sessions.help_bulk.other: Sign out other sessions ends all your other sign-ins after confirmation and keeps this browser signed in. It also cancels sign-ins waiting for a two-step code. Session actions do not revoke API tokens. If a sign-in has already expired or ended, refresh the inventory.

admin.reset.consequence.other: A one-time temporary password is created and shown to you once. The member's sessions and API tokens end, their recovery codes stop working, and they must choose a new password at next sign-in. Give them the temporary password in person or by a channel you trust.

admin.reset.throttled.other: Not done. You have reset too many passwords in the last hour. Try again later. Nothing changed.

admin.reset.shown_once.other: This is the only time it is shown.

admin.reset.instructions.other: Give it to %[1]s in person or by a channel you trust. They must choose a new password when they sign in. All their sessions and API tokens were ended.

admin.member_action.reason_hint.other: Required. It is recorded in the audit log.
